5601.grammar: abs of anodhiṃ karoti, comp vb
5601.meaning2: having made no limitation; having made no discrimination, having made no distinction

5602.meaning1: who has not gone beyond the limit
5602.commentary: (MNa) anodhijinassā'ti kiles'odhiṃ jinitvā ṭhitattā khīṇ'āsavo odhijino nāma, tasmā akhīṇ'āsavassā'ti attho.

examples.text: tattha katamā cha gehasitā upekkhā? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjati upekkhā bālassa mūḷhassa mandassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa anādīnavadassāvino assutavato puthujjanassa.

5603.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of anodhi, neg
5603.construction:
na > an + ava + √dhā + i + so
anodhi + so

examples.text: tato paraṃ, pañcah'ākārehi anodhisopharaṇā sattah'ākārehi odhisopharaṇā dasah'ākārehi disāpharaṇā'ti ayaṃ vikubbanā, sukhaṃ supatī'tiādayo ānisaṃsā ca mettāyaṃ vuttanayen'eva veditabbā'ti.

5604.meaning1: completely; without exception; without qualification; without limit

examples.text: cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?

5605.grammar: prp of na onamati, neg, intrans
5605.meaning1: not bending down; not bowing down; not stooping

examples.text: ṭhitako kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati parimajjati, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

5606.construction:
na > an + upa > opa + √mā + ā + *a
anopamā + *a

examples.text: akathaṃkathissa tusitassa, vantalok'āmisassa muditassa, katasamaṇassa manujassa, antimasārīrassa narassa, anopamassa virajassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
siddhatthaṃ lokapajjotaṃ, appameyyaṃ anopamaṃ, alatthaṃ paramaṃ pītiṃ, disvā dantaṃ jutin'dharaṃ.

5608.meaning2: not open to criticism, not censurable
5608.construction: na > an + upa > opa + ā + rambha + ya

examples.text: yo kho, mahārāja, manosamācāro n'ev'attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati. tassa akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti. evarūpo kho, mahārāja, manosamācāro anopārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī'ti.

5610.construction:
na > an + ava + ma
ano + ma

examples.text: paroparaṃ ariyadhammaṃ viditvā, mā mohayī jānam'anomavīriya, vāriṃ yathā ghammani ghammatatto, vāc'ābhikaṅkhāmi sutaṃ pavassa.
sayaṃ samattaṃ karoti paripuṇṇaṃ karoti anomaṃ karoti aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ karoti.

5611.meaning1: name of the royal capital of king Suppatita
5611.meaning2: name of the royal capital of king Suppatita
5611.construction:
na > an + ava + ma
ano + ma

examples.text: vassavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti. suppatitassa rañño anomaṃ nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.

5612.commentary: (MNa) anomajjatī'ti pāṇiṃ heṭṭhā otārento majjati, idaṃ taṃ, bho gotama, ārogyaṃ, idaṃ taṃ nibbānan'ti kālena sīsaṃ kālena uraṃ parimajjanto evam'āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, māgaṇḍiyo paribbājako sakān'eva sudaṃ gattāni pāṇinā anomajjati, idan'taṃ, bho gotama, ārogyaṃ, idan'taṃ nibbānaṃ. ahañ'hi, bho gotama, eta'r'ahi arogo sukhī, na maṃ kiñci ābādhatī'ti.
so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, tam'eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā patanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.
so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, tam'eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā patanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

5615.meaning2: not bowing; not stooping; not sinking

examples.text: anomanāmaṃ nipuṇ'atthadassiṃ, paññādadaṃ kām'ālaye asattaṃ, taṃ passatha sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, ariye pathe kamamānaṃ mahesin'ti.

5617.meaning1: with excellent effort; with superior endurance
5617.meaning2: of superior or excellent energy and exertion
5617.commentary: (DNa) anomanikkamo'ti anomavihārī seṭṭhavihārī. (MNa) sayho anomanikkamo'ti sayho nāma so buddho, anomavīriyattā pana anomanikkamo'ti vutto. (VVa) puripuṇṇavīriyatāya anomanikkamaṃ caturaṅgasamannāgatassa vīriyassa catubbidhasammappadhānassa ca pāripūriyā'ti attho.

examples.text: pabbajam'pi ca anomanikkamo, aggataṃ vajati sabbapāṇinaṃ, tena uttaritaro na vijjati, sabbalokam'abhibhuyya viharatī'ti.
durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.

5619.meaning1: who has superior strength; who possesses superior effort

examples.text: sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, anucchavikassa yad'ānulomikaṃ, taṃ vindati khippam'anomavikkamo'ti.

5620.meaning1: in reference to SN1.44 Ekamūlasutta and SN1.45 Anomasutta

examples.text: ādittaṃ kiṃdadaṃ annaṃ, ekamūlaanomiyaṃ, accharāvanaropajetaṃ, maccharena ghaṭīkaroti.

5623.meaning1: diligent in practice; active in nature; doing the required work

examples.text: lābhasakkārasilokena ca ye aññe dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāya chandaṃ janeti, vāyamati, anolīnavuttiko ca hoti asāthaliko.

5624.meaning2: not looking (at); not observing; not checking

5626.meaning2: not slipped down; not moved back; not reduced

5627.grammar: pp of na osāreti, neg, caus

examples.text: akaṭ'ānudhammo nāma ukkhitto anosārito.
samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.
ajja't'agge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho, ayam'pi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo'ti.

5631.grammar: prp of na ovadati, neg, trans (+acc)
5631.meaning1: not advising; not instructing; not admonishing

5633.meaning2: sheltered from the rain; not rained upon

5635.meaning2: sheltered from the rain; not rained upon

5638.meaning1: not giving advice; not instructing; not interfering
5638.commentary: (MNa) anovādī … tātā, kasatha, vapatha, vaṇippathaṃ payojethā'ti-ādinā hi nayena ovadanto ovādī nāma hoti.

examples.text: idha me, bho gotama, yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatth'āhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.

5639.meaning2: not leaving; not giving up; not abandoning

5640.grammar: adj, from pp of na sotaṃ odahati, comp, neg

examples.text: kathāsampayogena, bhikkhave, puggalo veditabbo yadi vā saupaniso yadi vā anupaniso'ti. anohitasoto, bhikkhave, anupaniso hoti, ohitasoto saupaniso hoti.
tattha akkharesu okār'antā aṭṭha sarā nāma.
sare pare antassa ekārassa kvaci yo ādeso hoti.
yattha nu kho, bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, sakkā nu kho so, bhante, gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā'ti?
es'ūpamā dāmali brāhmaṇassa, khīṇ'āsavassa nipakassa jhāyino, pappuyya jātimaraṇassa antaṃ, n'āyūhatī pāragato hi so'ti.
ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.
evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
atthi imasmiṃ kāye… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ (matthaluṅgaṃ), pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
atha kho so, bhikkhave, mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi. tam'enaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā saṅkhāditvā ajjhohari. tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi.

5645.meaning1: (gram) end; last letter; final syllable; final vowel (of)

examples.text: abbhāsassa antassa ivaṇṇo hoti, akāro vā. jigucchati, pivāsati, vīmaṃsati, jighacchati, babhūva, dadhāti. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? bubhukkhati.
abbhāsassa ante niggahit'āgamo hoti vā. caṅkamati, cañcalati, jaṅgamati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? pivāsati, daddallati.
sañcetanikā sukkavissaṭṭhi aññatra supin'antā saṅgh'ādiseso.

evaṃ, bhante. sace so, bhikkhave, dārukkhandho na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchati, na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchati, na majjhe saṃsīdissati, na thale ussīdissati, na manussaggāho gahessati, na amanussaggāho gahessati, na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūti bhavissati, evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, dārukkhandho samuddaninno bhavissati samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro. taṃ kissa hetu?
pupphāni h'eva pacinantaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, atittaññ'eva kāmesu, antako kurute vasaṃ.
sabbattha vihatā nandī, tamokhandho padālito, evaṃ jānāhi pāpima, nihato tvam'asi antaka.

5650.meaning1: who puts an end (to); who causes the death (of)

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.

5651.commentary: (SNa) antakiriyan'ti pariyantakaraṇaṃ. (SNa) dukkhassa antakiriyan'ti cattāri saccāni appaṭivijjhitvā avijjāya nivutānaṃ'y'eva sataṃ vaṭṭadukkhassa antakiriyaṃ paricchedaṃ na vadāmi.

examples.text: na c'āhaṃ, āvuso, appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
cetovimuttihīnā te, atho paññāvimuttiyā, abhabbā te antakiriyāya, te ve jātijar'ūpagā.

5652.meaning1: seized by death; assailed by death; overpowered by death

examples.text: na santi puttā tāṇāya, na pitā n'āpi bandhavā, antaken'ādhipannassa, n'atthi ñātīsu tāṇatā.
antaken'ādhipannassa, jahato mānusaṃ bhavaṃ, kiñ'hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, kiñ'ca ādāya gacchati, kiñ'c'assa anugaṃ hoti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.

5653.meaning2: having reached the end; thoroughly conversant with reaching perfection (in); extreme

5654.meaning1: twisted gut; intestinal knot; twisted bowels
5654.meaning2: twisted gut; knot of the intestine; twisted bowels

examples.text: jīvako… janaṃ ussāretvā tirokaraṇiyaṃ parikkhipitvā thambhe upanibandhitvā bhariyaṃ purato ṭhapetvā udaracchaviṃ uppāṭetvā antagaṇṭhiṃ nīharitvā bhariyāya dassesi
atthi imasmiṃ kāye… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ (matthaluṅgaṃ), pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
atha kho so, bhikkhave, mudumūsi gocarāya pakkāmi. tam'enaṃ biḷāro gahetvā sahasā saṅkhāditvā ajjhohari. tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi.

5658.meaning1: who has finished (with); who has concluded
5658.meaningLit: who has gone to the end (of)
5658.commentary: (SNPa) yo vaṭṭadukkhassa tīhi pariññāhi antagatattā antagū (NIDD1a) maraṇaṃ pāpanato antagū. (NIDD2a) akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ antaṃ gatattā antagū.

examples.text: antagū'si pāragū dukkhassa, arahā'si sammāsambuddho khīṇ'āsavaṃ taṃ maññe. jutimā mutimā pahūtapañño, dukkhass'antakaraṃ atāresi maṃ.
tam'āhu sekhaṃ paṭipadaṃ, atho saṃsuddhacāriyaṃ, tam'āhu loke sambuddhaṃ, dhīraṃ paṭipad'antaguṃ.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti.
hakāraṃ pañcameh'eva, antaṭṭhāhi ca saṃyutaṃ.

5664.commentary: (MNt) antadvayan'ti sassataṃ, ucchedaṃ, kāmasukhaṃ, attakilamathan'ti etaṃ antadvayaṃ. līn'uddhacca-patiṭṭhān'āyūhan'antadvayassa anupagamanaṃ atthasiddham'eva.

examples.text: ten'ev'āha ujugatāssa diṭṭhi dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato āgato imaṃ saddhamman'ti, lok'uttara-kusala-sammādiṭṭhi'y'eva hi antadvayam'anupagamma ujubhāvena gatattā

5666.meaning2: believing in the finiteness or limitless (of the world)

5667.commentary: (DNa) antam'antān'evā'ti koci maṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyā'ti pañhābhīto antam'antān'eva pantasen'āsanāni sevati.

examples.text: suññ'āgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā aparis'āvacaro samaṇo gotamo n'ālaṃ sallāpāya. so antapantān'eva sevati. seyyathā'pi nāma gokāṇā pariyantacārinī antam'antān'eva sevati.

5669.grammar: aor of antaṃ karoti, comp vb, intrans (+gen)

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabb'āsavasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mān'ābhisamayā antam'akāsi dukkhassā'ti
dukkhavepakkaṃ yadatthi kammaṃ, uddham'adho tiriyaṃ vā'pi majjhe, paribbājayitvā pariññacārī, māyaṃ mānam'atho'pi lobhakodhaṃ, pariyantam'akāsi nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ paribbājakam'āhu pattipattan'ti.

5671.meaning1: periphery; outskirts; remote place; somewhere out of the way
5671.commentary: (DNa) antam'antān'evā'ti koci maṃ pañhaṃ puccheyyā'ti pañhābhīto antam'antān'eva pantasen'āsanāni sevati.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gokāṇā pariyantacārinī antam'antān'eva sevati.

5672.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of antama
5672.meaning1: even so much as; even with; even down to; with as little as

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya. so taṃ māluvālataṃ mūle chindeyya, mūle chetvā palikhaṇeyya, palikhaṇitvā mūlāni uddhareyya, antamaso usīranāḷamattāni'pi.
yo vā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam'pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya… idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ.

5673.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of antama

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? antamaso gobhattam'pi bhavissatī'ti.

5674.meaning1: coming to the end; arriving at the end

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antam'āgamma, lokassa ante viharati. tam'aññe evam'āhaṃsu, ayam'pi lokapariyāpanno, ayam'pi anissaṭo lokamhā'ti. aham'pi hi, brāhmaṇā, evaṃ vadāmi, ayam'pi lokapariyāpanno, ayam'pi anissaṭo lokamhā'ti.
so kāmarāgaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati
kakusandho mahāvīro, sabbadhammāna pāragū, gaṇamhā vūpakaṭṭho so, agamāsi van'antaraṃ.

yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ek'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gām'antaram'pi aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, satthagamanīyo hoti maggo, sāsaṅkasammato, sappaṭibhayo, ayaṃ tattha samayo.

5678.commentary: (DHSt) kammato aññaṃ kammaṃ kamm'antaraṃ, taṃ kām'āvacar'ādiṃ rūp'āvacar'ādibhāvena, kaṇhavipāk'ādiṃ sukkavipāk'ādibhāvena kathento āloḷeti.

examples.text: dasabalañāṇesu hi paṭhamaṃ kāraṇ'ākāraṇam'eva jānāti. dutiyaṃ kamm'antara-vipāk'antaram'eva. tatiyaṃ kammaparicchedam'eva. catutthaṃ dhātunānattakāraṇam'eva. pañcamaṃ sattānaṃ ajjhāsay'ādhimuttim'eva.

5679.commentary: (MNa) dvaṭṭh'antarakappā'ti ekasmiṃ kappe catusaṭṭhi antarakappā nāma honti, ayaṃ pana aññe dve ajānanto evam'āha.

examples.text: pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca, dvaṭṭhipaṭipadā, dvaṭṭh'antarakappā, chaḷābhijātiyo, aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo, ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate

upavassaṃ kho pana kattikapuṇṇamaṃ yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni sen'āsanāni sāsaṅkasammatāni sappaṭibhayāni, tathārūpesu bhikkhu sen'āsanāni viharanto ākaṅkhamāno tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ antaraghare nikkhipeyya
kahaṃ nu kho, bhante, eta'r'ahi bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho? dassanakām'amhā mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan'ti. antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho kho, bāhiya, bhagavā piṇḍāyā'ti.

5681.commentary: (MNa) antaragharan'ti heṭṭhā mahāsakuludāyisutte indakhīlato paṭṭhāya antaragharaṃ, idha gharaummārato paṭṭhāya veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: so antaragharaṃ pavisanto na kāyaṃ unnāmeti, na kāyaṃ onāmeti, na kāyaṃ sannāmeti, na kāyaṃ vināmeti.

5682.meaning2: between the houses, among the houses (i.e. in the village); within a house

5683.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of antaraghara
5683.meaning1: inside a house; within a home

examples.text: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na hatthakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na pādakukkuccaṃ āpajjati, na adduvena adduvaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ āropetvā nisīdati, na ca pāṇinā hanukaṃ upadahitvā nisīdati.

5684.meaning1: augury of the thirty-two intermediate points of the compass

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā

5685.commentary: (SNa) chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko'ti kho, bhikkhave, nandīrāgass'etaṃ adhivacanan'ti ettha dvīh'ākārehi nandīrāgassa ukkhittāsikavadhakasadisatā veditabbā paññāsirapātanato ca yonisampaṭipādanato ca. kathaṃ? cakkhudvārasmiñhi iṭṭh'ārammaṇe āpāthagate taṃ ārammaṇaṃ nissāya lobho uppajjati, ettāvatā paññāsīsaṃ patitaṃ nāma hoti, sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo. evaṃ tāva paññāsirapātanato sadisatā veditabbā. nandīrāgo pan'esa aṇḍajādi-bhedā catasso yoniyo upaneti. (SNt) antaracaro'ti antaraṃ caro sukhasattu vissāsaghātī.

examples.text: ayaṃ te, ambho purisa, chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho yatth'eva naṃ passissāmi tatth'eva siro pātessāmī'ti. yaṃ te, ambho purisa, karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohī'ti.

5686.meaning1: in the coldest part of winter; during midwinter
5686.meaning2: coldest eight days of the winter, when snow falls (in India)
5686.commentary: (ANa) antar'aṭṭhako'ti māghaphagguṇānaṃ antare aṭṭhadivasaparimāṇo kālo. māghassa hi avasāne cattāro divasā, phagguṇassa ādimhi cattāro'ti ayaṃ antar'aṭṭhako'ti vuccati.

examples.text: sītā, bhante, hem'antikā ratti, antar'aṭṭhako himapātasamayo, kharā gokaṇṭakahatā bhūmi, tanuko paṇṇasantharo, viraḷāni rukkhassa pattāni, sītāni kāsāyāni vatthāni, sīto ca verambho vāto vāyati.
tena kho pana samayena te jaṭilā sītāsu hem'antikāsu rattīsu antar'aṭṭhakāsu himapātasamaye najjā nerañjarāya ummujjanti'pi, nimujjanti'pi, ummujjananimujjanam'pi karonti.

5689.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of antara

examples.text: yass'antarato na santi kopā, itibhav'ābhavatañ'ca vītivatto, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ? yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvit'indriyass'upacchedo, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ
evam'etesaṃ, bhikkhave, sutt'antānaṃ tathāgatabhāsitānaṃ gambhīrānaṃ gambhīr'atthānaṃ lok'uttarānaṃ suññatappaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ antaradhānaṃ bhavissati.

5691.grammar: pr, caus of antaradhāyati, comp vb
5691.meaning2: makes disappear; causes to disappear; eradicates

5692.grammar: pr, caus of antaradhāyati, comp vb, trans (+acc)
5692.meaning1: makes disappear; causes to disappear; eradicates

examples.text: bahuñ'ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū apuññaṃ pasavanti, te c'imaṃ saddhammaṃ antaradhāpenti.
ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.

5693.meaning1: made disappear; caused to disappear; eradicated
5693.commentary: (VINa) antaradhāpesun'ti vaggasaṅgaha-paṇṇāsasaṅgah'ādīhi asaṅgaṇhantā yaṃ yaṃ attano ruccati, taṃ tadeva gahetvā sesaṃ vināsesuṃ adassanaṃ nayiṃsu.

examples.text: handa carahi te, mārisa, passa antaradhāyāmī'ti. handa carahi me tvaṃ, brahme, antaradhāyassu, sace visahasī'ti.
esā antaradhāyāmi, kucchiṃ vā pavisāmi te, pakhum'antarikāyam'pi, tiṭṭhantiṃ maṃ na dakkhasi.

5696.commentary: (MNa) saddhamme antaradhāyamāne'ti paṭipattisaddhamme antaradhāyamāne. paṭipattisaddhammo'pi hi paṭipattipūrakesu sattesu asati antaradhāyati nāma.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, bhaddāli, hoti sattesu hāyamānesu, saddhamme antaradhāyamāne, bahutarāni c'eva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantī'ti.

5697.grammar: aor of antaradhāyati, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā, jānāti maṃ uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī'ti dukkhī dummano tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
ahu kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ ānakassa mudiṅgassa porāṇaṃ pokkharaphalakaṃ antaradhāyi, āṇisaṅghāṭo'va avasissi.

5698.grammar: inf of antaradhāyati, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, bako brahmā antaradhāyissāmi samaṇassa gotamassa, antaradhāyissāmi samaṇassa gotamassā'ti n'eva'ssu me sakkoti antaradhāyituṃ

5699.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of antarantara

examples.text: saccaṃ vadatī'ti saccavādī. saccena saccaṃ sandahati ghaṭetī'ti saccasandho. na antar'antarā musā vadatī'ti attho.
